caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a dark green frame. The chair features three horizontal slats on the backrest and has curved armrests that end in rounded knobs. The chair seat appears to be woven, with a brownish hue and slight texture indicating the weaving. Decorative gold or yellow accents are visible on some of the frame’s joints, spindles, and legs. The legs are straight and connected with horizontal rung supports near the base. The chair is positioned centrally on a light, plain background, and there is a signature reading “Sarkis Erganian” toward the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Dining Room Chair
